relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings provide evidence that EZH2 protein expression in microglia is positively regulated by the TLR4 signaling pathway.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal administration of CGRP resulted in increased expression of both EZH2 and H3K27me3 in the spinal dorsal horn [10].

relationships.subject: miR-124-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: Through bioinformatic and luciferase analyses, it was demonstrated that miR-124-3p suppressed EZH2 protein expression by binding to the 3′-untranslated region (3′-UTR) of EZH2.

relationships.subject: miR-378
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicate that spinal protein expression of EZH2 and neuropathic pain are negatively regulated by miR-378 [15].

relationships.subject: EZH2
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, in BV2 microglial cells with EZH2 protein overexpression by plasmid vectors containing the EZH2 gene, microglial activation and production of pro-inflammatory mediators (TNF-α, IL-1β, MCP-1) from BV2 microglia induced by LPS stimulation were further exaggerated [13].

relationships.subject: GSK126
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, mechanical and cold allodynia induced by brachial plexus avulsion was attenuated when animals received systemic treatment with GSK-126 (7 mg/kg) (i.p.) daily from day 1 to 14 post-brachial plexus avulsion [11].

key_findings: EZH2 and H3K27me3 are elevated in nerve, spinal dorsal horn and ACC in neuropathic pain, and EZH2 inhibition (DZNep, GSK-126) reduces neuroinflammation and pain.
EZH2 is upregulated by TLR4 and CGRP signaling and suppressed by miR-124-3p and miR-378.
